The [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] '''''Derapha''''' was a part of the [[Phaeda Planetary Defense Force]]. It was named after one of the largest cities on [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]], [[Derapha]].

In [[3962 BBY]], the ''Derapha'' intercepted the [[Axehead frigate]] ''[[Reciprocity]]'' upon its entry into the [[Phaeda system/Legends|Phaeda system]], and redirected it to [[Phaedacomm]].
